relationships.subject: NMDAR2B
relationships.evidence_quote: Further activation or inhibition of the NMDAR2B receptor resulted in corresponding increases or decreases in the expression of downstream PKA, CREB, and BDNF proteins and mRNAs, accompanied by changes in the peripheral esophageal sensitizers SP and CGRP.

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: These observations indicate that activation of the PKA pathway can increase the phosphorylation levels of kinases to induce downstream BDNF expression by regulating CREB expression and transcriptional activity

relationships.subject: NMDAR2B
relationships.evidence_quote: The NMDAR2B signaling pathway plays a critical role in the development of neuropathic pain in GERD through the PKA/CREB/BDNF pathway.

key_findings: In a GERD rat model, NMDAR2B, PKA, CREB, BDNF, SP and CGRP were elevated in cingulate, thalamus, dorsal horn and esophagus; agonists/antagonists shifted levels and behavioral scores.
NMDAR2B-PKA-CREB-BDNF pathway proposed to mediate esophageal hypersensitivity.
